pages.title: Springbok
pages.text: The springbok ($(o)Antidorcas marsupialis$()) is a gazelle-like antelope of the dry plains and scrublands of southern and southwestern Africa.$(br2)It is famous for pronking, a series of stiff-legged leaps high into the air, often performed when a predator is near.$(br2)Springbok can go for long periods without drinking, getting most of their water from the plants they eat.
